Guidance (from Agile Delivery Playbook)
- An Epic is a multi-month outcome or standing capability. It does not receive day-to-day tasks.
- Leadership cares about Epic status (On track / At risk / Parked / Done).
- Detailed scope, approach, capacity, and Done-When criteria belong in the Feature-s Proposal for Work or Statement of Work.
- Keep this document short. Process overhead must stay below the value it creates.
